## Quarterly sales at a glance

Sales grew **12%** on the previous quarter, driven by *online orders*.

- Online: 4,210 orders
- In store: 1,980 orders
  - Weekends made up 41% of these

1. Check the returns rate
2. Compare with last year

| Region | Orders | Change |
|:-------|-------:|-------:|
| North  | 2,340  | +9%    |
| South  | 3,850  | +14%   |

```sql
SELECT region, count(*) AS orders FROM sales GROUP BY region;
```

> Figures are rounded.
